# Shipit

> Shipit is a free browser-based release video maker that turns a product logo,
> optional screenshot, name, version, and release details into a five-second celebration film.

Canonical URL: https://shipit.xingkaixin.me/

## Capabilities

- Creates landscape and portrait product release videos.
- Exports 1080p or 4K MP4 files at 30 or 60 FPS.
- Provides independently selectable backgrounds and color themes.
- Frames product screenshots in a browser, MacBook, or iPhone, or without a frame.
- Supports English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese.
- Processes uploaded assets and encodes video locally in the browser.

## Browser requirements

MP4 export requires a modern browser with H.264 WebCodecs encoding support.
4K exports use a browser-local temporary file when available.

## Privacy

Uploaded logos, previews, and encoded videos remain in the user's browser and
are not uploaded to Shipit or Cloudflare.

## Usage and example

[Product guide and real export example](https://shipit.xingkaixin.me/#product-guide)
explains how to add assets, choose a style, and export an MP4.

Output support depends on the browser and device. Shipit checks the selected
configuration at runtime; use 1080p on mobile or memory-constrained devices.
Saved projects stay in the current browser and do not sync between devices.
